caption: The drawing depicts six wooden figurines arranged in a row, each consisting of a carved and painted human head and torso mounted on a cylindrical body with a single black boot as the base. The first figure on the left has a dark brown face with short textured hair, and its clothing is painted in muted greens and browns. The second figure has a lighter complexion with short, light brown hair, and its faded clothing is painted in greens, reds, and browns. The third figure has a light brown face and hair, distinct facial hair, and a simple brown shirt. The fourth figure features a red helmet or hat, a lighter face, and attire painted in green and yellow. The fifth figure wears a light helmet with ear flaps, a pale shirt, and a tan cylindrical body. The sixth figure has a dark headgear covering the hair, a brown face, and a shirt with three small yellow buttons. All figures have cylindrical, wood-textured bodies connected to a black, high boot for the lower segment. The background is a plain, off-white surface. The objects are composed so that all six figures are aligned side by side, evenly spaced in the composition.
title: Pa. German Pins
